'''Gulaeve Annallin''' is a [[Cairhien]]in noblewoman.

==History==
She is an elderly noblewoman, who is ailing in health and is relatively frail. However, she retains her interest in the arts, channelers, and lore, which makes her a patron of unusual guests at her parties.

There is some dispute whether her illness is truly natural, or whether it is the result of poison from a rival house.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
